rationale: With the Chief in the majority and explicitly favoring a narrow, administrable holding, Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion to a Koontz-consistent rule rejecting a categorical legislative carveout while reserving how rough proportionality applies to fee schedules. Separate writings are most likely from Thomas/Gorsuch (to press a more categorical, text-driven approach) and from Kagan/Sotomayor (to emphasize workability and evidentiary showings for generally applicable fees).
